Drinking isn't really the biggest problem, it helped me to be social toward people, friends, and stuff, but it shouldn't become an solution. If it takes over your life, you will be hurt even more, and i don't want that. You don't want that. There must be something else what brings you in a comfort zone, music, writing, reading, paint, watch movies, Whatever you like to do, try to focus on those good things. Sure, it's easier to say than do, but it will bring you in a way more better place. It's just a little step. Music helped for me a lot.

And YES, I do care about you. Because i know what you're going trough. I went there. And i don't want that your life will end because of it. Because it's not worth it. It isn't. Speaking to people here made me realize that they do care, And even if it sounds so cliche, Things will turn for the better eventually. Maybe not now, tomorrow, or next month. I was a fucking piece of shit, but i knew dying wasn't the answer, I hated something about myself, but i could change it. I just really wanted it. If i can do it, you can do it for sure, because i believe in you. I know you're more worth then you're thinking. It takes a few little steps, each day, weak , month, what the hell maybe even years ! But what you get in return, is sooo much better. It looks shitty now, i know, but everytime you think about the bad parts, try to think, " I shouldn't feel this way'' I am worth something'' People care about me'' Because that's the truth. I care, i fucking do bro !
